about: Orientation conventions of the tools Vesqira reads, as data (ADR 0068, item 2). A profile maps header cards to the fields of an orientation declaration. Everything it supplies is labelled declared by profile:<name>@<version>, never verified. A field the profile cannot place stays unresolved: nothing is assumed.

profiles.name: VGT.jl

statistics.note: VGT.jl's psi is an axial orientation in radians (README); the BUNIT card states the unit
